scientific_integrity: A complete elementary all-length proof is given; finite reproducible verification supplements it. Prior upper bounds are attributed and no priority or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Hamming weight exactly three and binary alphabet only.
The primitive-rotation upper-bound technique is previously established; only saturation construction and resulting optimum are proposed here.
Equivalent earlier specialization not exhaustively excludable; independent review has not been performed.
title: Optimal constant-weight-three binary non-overlapping codes are primitive-necklace transversals
